# VertexPortal LMS — Complete Platform Specification & Documentation

## 1. Platform Summary
VertexPortal (https://vertex-mu-eight.vercel.app/) is a scalable, cloud-native learning management platform built with React, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Gemini AI.

## 2. Core Modules
### 2.1 Course Catalog & Learning Management
- Comprehensive course curriculum with video lectures, reading modules, and attached resources.
- Progress tracking with automatic lesson completion and bookmarking.
- Discussion forums attached to individual lectures and global community boards.

### 2.2 Assessments & Examinations
- Multiple choice, coding challenges, and essay question formats.
- Real-time timer and automated grading with instant scorecard generation.
- Instructor grading interface for subjective assignments.

### 2.3 AI Tutor Assistant
- Context-aware explanations of course topics.
- Interactive code debugging with line-by-line breakdown.
- Study plan generator based on student goals and schedule.

### 2.4 Code Playground
- Multi-language interactive compiler & execution sandbox.
- Syntax highlighting, auto-formatting, and error diagnostics.

### 2.5 Security & Privacy
- Strict transport security (HSTS), Content-Security-Policy (CSP), and role-based access control (RBAC).
- Data privacy compliant with GDPR principles.
